rows.grounds: past participle of pīḍ, nominative plural masculine

items.question: Are beings tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: There are eighty-four thousand such diagrams.
Torment occurs across all of them.
items.inference: The verse states universal torment across eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: Exact referent of yoniyantreṣu is unclear.
Agreement of pīḍitāḥ with an implied subject is unspecified.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
